content:
Priya: Noticing a cluster of duplicate token charges from EU mobile traffic around 18:05UTC. Client sees a close then resumes immediately.

Marco: Any idea if the proxy is cutting early?

Priya: Yes, proxy idle timeout (60s) fires while runtime is still streaming a partial SSE chunk. Proxy returns 204+close. Client then issues resume and we end up with two charge events.

Hannah: Is this SSE-only? WS paths behave differently.

Priya: Mostly SSE from flaky mobile networks.

Marco: Quick wins: bump keepalive for streaming routes behind flag and add a short server-side grace when EOF happens mid-chunk so we can coalesce charges.

Hannah: Runtime change needs a feature flag `stream.midchunk_grace` and a dedupe store keyed by resume_parent_id with TTL=2m. Also emit `resume_parent_id` on all charge events.

Priya: Console side: group charges by resume_parent_id by default for internal views, show merge suggestion to billing team.

Marco: Rollout plan: proxy flag to canary 10% -> runtime flag canary -> monitor `billing.duplicate_ratio` and `stream.resume_attempts`.

ops-bot: Canary deploy started for proxy MR #5021 (eng-prod-canary 10%).

Hannah: I'll own the runtime PR and tests (unit for dedupe, integration repro with slow SSE).

Priya: I'll collect sample trace ids and coordinate with billing on policy.

Marco: Great. Re-evaluate after canary metrics in ~2h.
